notes.title: Patch 1.6: Custom Map Improvements
notes.notes:
Patch 1.6 improves custom map support

You can learn how to make maps here: [url=http://www.footnotesforthefuture.com/guides-and-resources/ballistic-zen-custom-maps/]http://www.footnotesforthefuture.com/guides-and-resources/ballistic-zen-custom-maps/[/url]

Join the discord to share maps with others! [url=https://discord.gg/XS29Pdr]https://discord.gg/XS29Pdr[/url]

Changes:

[list]
[*] Added trigger to force player respawn (i.e. death pitts)
[*] Added trigger to set player respawn points (i.e. named spawn 'hubs')
[*] Added support for custom textures (see tutorial)
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.5: Custom Maps
notes.notes:
Patch 1.5 brings the experimental custom maps feature.

You can learn how to make maps here: [url=http://www.footnotesforthefuture.com/guides-and-resources/ballistic-zen-custom-maps/]http://www.footnotesforthefuture.com/guides-and-resources/ballistic-zen-custom-maps/[/url]

Join the discord to share maps with others! [url=https://discord.gg/XS29Pdr]https://discord.gg/XS29Pdr[/url]

Changes:

[list]
[*] Experimental Custom Maps feature
[*] Lines can cross themselves!
[*] NPCs are more common
[*] Replace skin with heat-resistant wraps on the arm model
[*] Cars will stop bobbing when you're near them so you can land your jumps
[*] NPCs will no longer stop you if you're going at a high speed
[*] Custom Lines no longer reflected in game complete screen
[*] Fixed some dialogue typos
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.4: Custom Lines
notes.notes:
​Patch 1.4 brings the experimental custom lines feature. Join the discord to share lines with others! https://discord.gg/XS29Pdr

​Changes:

[list]
[*] Experimental Custom Lines feature
[*] A few more collectables
[*] Fix broken respect indicator
[*] Customise Turn and Speed indicator locations
[*] Toggle arms on and off
[*] Invert Y Axis
[*] Fix loud audio bug
[*] Make Turn Indicator more responsive
[*] Kill a particularly broken speedrun
[*] Fix invisible walls
[/list]

notes.title: Pre-Release Patch 1.3
notes.notes:
I've been playing this game for so long and still I'm finding bugs:

[list]
[*] Fixed a hard crash related to the Line director
[*] Fixed some lines instantly failing
[/list]

notes.title: Pre Release Patch 1.2
notes.notes:
Release is so soon aaaah! Pre-release patch 1.2 fixes some last minute things:

[list]
[*] Makes lines more common
[*] Fixes some level geo in pyramid
[*] Fix some dialogue
[*] Ghost now has an interest in poetry
[/list]
